title_tag: 9 Best Photoshoots in Dubai (2026): Prices Compared
meta_description: Private Dubai photographers and flying dress shoots compared on price, edited photos, delivery time, pickup and locations, from the Burj Khalifa to the dunes.
author_role: 9 Dubai photoshoots compared on price, edited photos, delivery time, flying dress and pickup
lead: For most visitors the best photoshoot in Dubai is the private shoot with hotel pickup at €143 per person: the photographer drives you to the spots you pick and delivers around 50 edited photos per location. Couples on a tighter budget get a private Burj Khalifa shoot with 25 edited photos in 48 hours for €94 for two.

Here for the flying dress? The cheapest shoot with the dress included is the Burj Khalifa flying dress shoot at €211 for two: one dress delivered to your hotel, 20–25 edited photos and two edited reels within 24 hours. For dunes instead of towers, the private desert flying dress trip (€499 for two) adds pickup and a dune drive.

The camera is not what separates these shoots. How many photos are edited, how fast they arrive, whether the dress is included and who gets you to the spot are: edited counts below run from 14 to about 150, and delivery from 24 hours to 25 days. All 9 are compared side by side below.

review: This is the shoot to book if you only book one. For €143 per person a private photographer picks you up at your hotel, drives you to the spots you chose from their list, coaches your poses and sends around 50 edited photos per location. Add a second or third location and the edited count rises to about 100 or 150, which is far more finished images than anything else here.

The pickup is what sets it apart from the cheaper Downtown shoots. The Downtown shoots on this page meet you at Wings of Mexico or Souk Al Bahar by the Burj Khalifa, so you pay a taxi and stick to one district. Here the car is part of the price, which makes it realistic to combine, say, the Burj Khalifa area with a beach or Marina spot in one session.

Two catches. The price is per person, so a couple pays about €286, more than the per-couple Downtown options. And the flying dress is not part of the base price: it is listed at 200 AED per person. If the dress is the point of the shoot, the #2 pick includes one.

guide.h2: Dubai Photoshoots Compared Side by Side
guide.html:
The nine shoots on the points that decide the booking: price, shoot length, edited photos, delivery time, locations, whether a flying dress is included, hotel pickup and who else is there. Prices are from-prices in euros for a normal date; "for 2" means one price for up to two people.

Three numbers stand out. Per edited photo, the #1 pick (about €2.90), the proposal shoot (about €2.60) and the Burj Khalifa couple shoot (under €4) are the cheapest; the Floganza shoot works out at about €57 per edited photo, because you are paying for two dresses, transport and RAW files. For a couple, per-group prices change the picture: the #1 pick costs about €286 for two, more than the €211 flying dress shoot. And only three shoots include hotel pickup: #1, #3 and #8.

• Most photos for the money, door to door: the private photoshoot with hotel pickup. Add a second location for about 100 edited photos.
  • Flying dress with the Burj Khalifa: the Burj Khalifa flying dress video shoot, best for couples; solo travellers add 200 AED for an assistant.
  • Flying dress in the desert: the desert flying dress and dune drive for two, or Floganza if you want two dresses and a longer session and price is no object.
  • Couple, engagement or honeymoon on a budget: the Burj Khalifa couple photoshoot; take the 2-hour option to get the raw files.
  • Proposal: the proposal photoshoot with a hidden photographer, or the personal travel photographer if you want the spots planned to your brief.
  • Family or group: Picster from €80 for up to 20 for the price, Pictrip at €263 for up to 6 for a tailored plan.
  • Staying in Dubai Marina, want to pick your own edits: the Marina photo tour.

guide.h2: Practical Tips: Flying Dresses, Timing and What Costs Extra
guide.html:
How the flying dress works

The "flying" effect is a person lifting and throwing the train while the photographer shoots, so bring a partner or pay for an assistant (200 AED on the #2 pick). Dresses are chosen from a catalogue after booking; on the #2 pick it is delivered to your hotel the day before. A second dress costs 350 AED there, while Floganza includes two. Only #2, #3 and #8 include a dress in the price; #1, #5 and the add-on menus elsewhere charge for one.

Where to shoot

Most city shoots start at the Wings of Mexico statue or Souk Al Bahar in Downtown and walk a loop with the Burj Khalifa behind you: Dubai Mall Park Bridge, Burj Park, the Dandelion sculpture, Burj Ceni and Dubai Opera. If you also want to go up the tower, book that separately (compare Burj Khalifa tickets): no shoot here includes admission. For dunes, the desert shoots handle transport; for Old Dubai's souks and abras, Picster is the only listing here that names it. For a broader sightseeing day, see our Dubai city tours.

Heat and what to bring

Most shoots here are outdoors. Listings ask you to bring comfortable shoes, sunglasses, a hat, water and sun protection, and the #1 pick suggests a change of clothes. In the hot months, ask your photographer for an early or late slot when you book. Sunrise over the desert from the air is another option: see hot air balloon flights.

What costs extra

Check these before you pay: hotel transfers (included only on #1, #3 and #8), flying dress hire, a solo assistant, extra photos or premium edits, drone footage, short videos and make-up or hair. None of the shoots includes food or drinks.

faqs.q: How much does a photoshoot in Dubai cost?
faqs.a: Private shoots start at about €80 for a group (Picster, smallest package) and €94 for a couple (Burj Khalifa couple shoot with 25 edited photos). A private shoot with hotel pickup is €143 per person. Flying dress shoots run from €211 for two in Downtown to €499 for two in the desert and €799 per person for Floganza.

faqs.q: Where can I do a flying dress photoshoot in Dubai?
faqs.a: The two classic settings are Downtown, with the Burj Khalifa behind you (from €211 for two, dress included, meeting at the Wings of Mexico statue), and the desert dunes (from €499 for two with pickup and a dune drive). Floganza also shoots in the desert, with two dresses, for €799 per person.

Only on three of the nine shoots: the Burj Khalifa flying dress shoot (1 dress), the desert flying dress and dune drive trip (1 dress) and Floganza (2 dresses). Elsewhere it is an add-on, for example 200 AED per person on the #1 pick.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get the photos?
faqs.a: From 24 hours to about 25 days. The Burj Khalifa flying dress shoot delivers edited reels within 24 hours; the couple shoot, Picster and the Marina tour deliver within 48 hours; Pictrip within 5 working days. The desert shoots are slowest: about two weeks for #3 and up to 25 days for Floganza's retouched photos.

faqs.q: What is the best couple photoshoot in Dubai?
faqs.a: For value, the Burj Khalifa couple and pre-wedding shoot: €94 for two, 25 edited photos within 48 hours, or 30 plus raw files on the 2-hour option. For a flying dress, the €211 Burj Khalifa shoot is priced for two and needs a partner to throw the dress anyway.

faqs.q: Can I hire a photographer for a proposal in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. The proposal photoshoot in Downtown (€130 for up to 10) has the photographer hide and step out at the moment, with 50 edited photos. The Pictrip personal photographer (€263 for up to 6) plans the locations to your brief.

faqs.q: Do Dubai photoshoots include hotel pickup?
faqs.a: Only three do: the private photoshoot with hotel pickup (#1), the desert flying dress and dune drive (#3) and Floganza (#8). The Downtown shoots meet at Wings of Mexico or Souk Al Bahar, and the Marina tour at Stefano's in Dubai Marina.

methodology: We compared 9 bookable private photoshoots in Dubai: city shoots in Downtown, Old Dubai and Dubai Marina, flying dress shoots by the Burj Khalifa and in the desert, and a proposal shoot. Each was compared on price and price per edited photo, shoot length, number of edited photos, delivery time, locations, whether a flying dress is included, hotel pickup and group size, plus what you pay on top (assistants, extra dresses, transport, add-ons). Prices are live listing from-prices for a normal date; ratings come from verified guest reviews.
